verdict.rationale: Instinct's own Google Workspace integration gives it access to Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides, and its terms mention user-added 'Materials' in a Vault. One user also reports using it for work on an LP data room, which suggests it can work with document contents. Nothing documents direct uploads, PDF handling, or the quality of the analysis. Missing for 10: an explicit file-upload flow, PDF support, documented spreadsheet and document analysis, and hands-on evidence that the analysis is accurate.
